companyAnnouncements: 📋 Copy Mode: Ctrl+A [ (enter) | / (search) | v (select) | y (copy) | p (paste)
🪟 Windows: Ctrl+A c (new) | Ctrl+A n/p (next/prev) | Ctrl+A & (kill) | Ctrl+A , (rename)
📐 Panes: Ctrl+A - (h-split) | Ctrl+A _ (v-split) | Ctrl+A hjkl (navigate) | Ctrl+A z (zoom)
🎯 Sessions: Ctrl+A d (detach) | Ctrl+A s (list) | Ctrl+A Ctrl+F (find) | Ctrl+A $ (rename)
🔍 Search in Copy: Ctrl+A [ then / (forward) or ? (backward) | n/N (next/prev match)
📏 Resize Panes: Ctrl+A HJKL (hold and repeat for continuous resize)
🖱️ Mouse: Ctrl+A m (toggle) | Scroll=copy-mode | Drag-border=resize | Click=switch-pane
⚡ Quick: Ctrl+A q (show pane numbers) | Ctrl+A x (kill pane) | Ctrl+A Space (layouts)
💾 Buffers: Ctrl+A b (list buffers) | Ctrl+A P (choose buffer) | Ctrl+A p (paste)
🔧 Config: Ctrl+A r (reload) | Ctrl+A e (edit) | Ctrl+A ? (help) | Ctrl+A : (command)
